relations.note: Later genealogical systematization makes Mayahuel mother of the Four Hundred Rabbits.
relations.source: Magliabechiano-group imagery and colonial mythographic texts

relations.note: Many-breasted Mayahuel nourishes the pulque gods, expressing abundant flows of maguey sap.
Later accounts make Patecatl father of the collective with Mayahuel.
relations.source: Sixteenth-century deity lists and colonial compilations

relations.note: Ometochtli functions as chief, calendrical representative, or collective embodiment of the group.
Their mountain and fertility functions overlap, without established kinship or service.
Taube proposes overlap between the two drunken, stellar, sacrificial collectives.
